## Description

Create all 48 government UI/UX anti-pattern YAML files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/anti-patterns/ sourced from epic 17de-a47a. Update _index.yaml.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Read epic 17de-a47a (archived) to extract all 48 anti-patterns
- [ ] >=48 YAML files created in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/anti-patterns/
- [ ] Each file has: rule_id (ap- prefix, unique, e.g. ap-session-timeout-missing), prior_art, precedence, domain ([auth|forms|navigation|visual] per content type), compliance/severity/story_type tags as applicable
- [ ] Domain tag mapping documented in file comment: session/auth patterns → domain:[auth]; form patterns → domain:[forms]; navigation patterns → domain:[navigation]; visual/display patterns → domain:[visual]
- [ ] Summary + Detail tiers populated for all entries; Implementation is stretch
- [ ] No file exceeds 500 lines
- [ ] check-corpus-schema passes on all anti-patterns/ files with no vocabulary violations
- [ ] ref-query returns >=1 result for 'session timeout' with domain:[auth]
- [ ] _index.yaml updated with all 48 new entries
- [ ] Comment added to epic 17de-a47a noting its content has been absorbed into the corpus
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_anti_patterns.py pass (GREEN)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: 48 entries from 17de-a47a, schema-valid, Summary+Detail
- DD2: Domain tag canonical values (auth/forms/navigation/visual), documented in comment
- DD3: _index.yaml updated + --validate-index passes
- DD4: check-corpus-schema passes
- DD5: ref-query 'session timeout' returns auth-tagged result

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/anti-patterns/*.yaml (48 files) [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_index.yaml [UPDATE]
